Priya S: heads up — after the 1778 deploy we're seeing a 12-18% CPU regression on host-side parsing for streaming requests. latency tail at p95 looks worse for short responses.
Matt R: saw that in the dashboard, looks correlated with grpc header handling? any flamegraphs yet? :eyes:
Priya S: uploaded a pprof snapshot to /tmp/profiles/1778890000-flame.svg and pushed to the perf bucket. main hotspot is `ingress::header_normalize` + allocations in the preparse buffer.
Keiko: weird — kernel-selection change shouldn't touch header code. Could batching heuristics cause more small requests to hit a slow path?
Priya S: that's my hunch. Batching tweak reduced average batch wait but increased microbursts that hit the proto-unpack cold path. KV cache eviction rate also climbed ~6% during the window.
Sam O: can you paste the allocation stack for the header hotspot?
Priya S: here —
```
ingress::header_normalize
preparse::ensure_contiguous
buffer::grow (x3)
proto::unpack_small_frame
```
Matt R: buffer::grow multiple times = memcopy churn. Maybe our streaming chunk assembler changed chunk boundaries after the recent writev coalesce.
perf-bot: new profile processed: 1778890000 (p95_cpu +13%) — suggested probe: reduce preparse buffer grow threshold + log sample of smallwrite sizes.
Keiko: can we reproduce locally with the mini-bench? run `tools/bench/stream-slim --qps 200 --smallwrites` and collect pprof.
Sam O: I'll run that and also toggle `INGRESS_SMALLWRITE_COALESCE=false` in the local config to confirm.
Priya S: also try patching `preparse::ensure_contiguous` to reserve an extra 128 bytes to avoid repeated grows. Quick patch proof-of-concept in my branch priya/buffer-reserve.
Matt R: if that fixes CPU it's a good short-term mitigation. longer-term we should look at batching heuristics: prefer stable chunk boundaries for streaming to keep proto unpack fast.
Keiko: noted — I'll open a follow-up PR to add a regression test covering smallwrites + kvcache pressure. Can someone add a perf regression alert for ingress p95 CPU when kv-evict rate > 5%?
Priya S: created ticket INF-1129 and linked the profile + bench logs. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
Matt R: nice investigation. keep the follow-ups minimal and let's schedule a canary before rolling to prod.
